Cell manufacturer Suniva and module manufacturer Heliene announced a deal in March with polysilicon and wafer manufacturer Corning to produce an all-domestic PV module (Suniva 2025). 2.5.4 Regional Costs for Ingots and Wafers Figure 20 shows NLR-calculated costs for ingot and wafer production by region. The equipment and materials for ingot and wafer manufacturing have primarily become centered in China; thus, China has the lowest equipment and material delivery costs. Outside China, variations in equipment and facilities CapEx and materials costs are driven by distance from the principal suppliers, trade policies, manufacturing experience and workforce capabilities, and highly variable EPC costs. Section 301 tariffs on materials from China, excluding polysilicon, add 25% to U.S. costs. Most ingot and wafer equipment was exempted from 25% tariffs in September 2024, retroactive to May 2024, so these tariffs are not included in our cost analysis. On May 31, 2025, the 1-year tariff exemption for solar wafer equipment from China was extended to August 31, 2025.24 It has around $3/kW of value assuming 7-year linear depreciation of CapEx for ingot and wafer dc equipment.
